report.summary: Chunk 4 of harness.py: includes _target_query, _repo_chunks, _bm25_tokenize, _bm25_scores, and _bm25_context (partial). Claims about sorting, tokenization, BM25 formula, and tie-breaking are checked against visible code.

handoff.purpose: Define retrieval helpers: _target_query, _repo_chunks, _bm25_tokenize, _bm25_scores, and start of _bm25_context.

symbols.name: _target_query
symbols.note: Returns BM25 query string from target: if '::' present, returns part after '::'; else returns stem of last path component.

symbols.name: _repo_chunks
symbols.note: Walks root, reads files, extracts units via extract_units, returns list of (label, source) tuples. Sorts dirnames and filenames.

symbols.name: _bm25_tokenize
symbols.note: Tokenizes text using _BM25_TOKEN_RE, returns list of lowercased tokens.

symbols.name: _bm25_scores
symbols.note: Computes Okapi BM25 scores for query tokens over doc tokens, with k1=1.2, b=0.75.

symbols.name: _bm25_context
symbols.note: Partial implementation: selects top-k BM25 chunks up to budget_tokens, returns dict with text, counts, truncated flag.

claims.text: BM25 query fallback when a task has no ``question``: the target symbol name, or the file's stem for a file-level target.
claims.why: Function returns part after '::' if present (symbol name), else returns stem of last path component (file stem).

claims.text: Retrieval units for arm C: one chunk per extractable unit (function or class), else the whole file when nothing is extractable -- "the repo's files/units" the BM25 baseline retrieves over.
claims.why: Code calls extract_units; if units exist, creates chunk per unit; else uses whole file text.
_whole_repo_text not defined in this chunk; cannot verify equivalence.

claims.text: Unlike ``_whole_repo_text``, dirnames ARE sorted here: this is new code with no prior byte-order contract to preserve, and BM25 tie-breaking needs a deterministic candidate order (see ``_bm25_context``).
claims.why: Code sorts dirnames with sorted() and filters _IGNORE_DIRS and dot-directories.

claims.text: Okapi BM25 over pre-tokenized docs -- no new dependency, no network.
claims.why: Uses only math.log and standard Python; no network calls.

claims.text: Ties are broken by the CALLER (chunk label, not insertion order) so retrieval order stays deterministic regardless of dict/set iteration order (PYTHONHASHSEED).
claims.why: In _bm25_context, order is sorted by (-score, label) where label is chunks[i][0]; this is deterministic.

claims.text: Top-k BM25 retrieval up to ``budget_tokens`` -- arm C.
claims.why: Function selects chunks until sum of token counts exceeds budget_tokens.

claims.text: Chunks are taken whole, never split mid-chunk; the single best-ranked chunk is always included even if it alone exceeds budget (an empty context is a strictly worse baseline than a slightly-over one).
claims.why: Code adds whole block; if block tokens exceed budget, it is still included because loop does not check budget before adding first chunk.

claims.text: ``truncated`` is True iff a lower-ranked chunk existed that did not fit the remaining budget.
claims.why: The function body is incomplete; the logic for setting truncated is not fully visible.

observations.what: In _whole_repo_text (previous chunk), dirnames are NOT sorted; here in _repo_chunks dirnames ARE sorted.
_target_query handles both '::' and file-level targets correctly.
BM25 tokenizer uses a regex that matches identifiers with underscores and digits, but not dots or other characters.
_bm25_context is incomplete; the function body ends mid-loop before setting truncated.
In _bm25_scores, if avgdl is 0 (all docs empty), division by zero avoided by using 1.0.
